out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Chemical Sanitizing, Contact Time Met
violations.observation: Chemical sanitizer was inadequate for sanitizing in the main warewashing machine in the kitchen, The chlorine level was 0 ppm.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Instead, manually wash, rinse, and sanitize all equipment and utensils in the three compartment sink. Repair the dishmachine so that the sanitizer level is 50 ppm or the manufacturers specification. Contact your EHS when this has been corrected. Follow-up is required. The person in charge stopped using the machine and said she would use the three compartment sink until the machine is fixed.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: the mechanical warewashing machine in the kitchen was not sanitizing. The EHS and person in charge tried to adjust the unit, but could not. Chlorine bleach sanitizer was not flowing through the tube, indicating a problem with the prime or a damaged tube.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Please have the unit adjusted or repaired as soon as possible. Correct this as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months. Contact your EHS when this is corrected.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The condensation from a ceiling mounted HVAC over the warewashing area is draining from a green garden hose and into an overflowing container on the three compartment sink. The three compartment sink can used for clean equipment equipment, utensils and food and the HVAC unit condensation should not be draining into it.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. To correct this, the HVAC unit should be repaired, but according to the person in charge, it has been like this for four months. Until repaired, it is recommended that the draining hose be moved from the three compartment sink to the mop sink, which is located next to the three compartment sink. Please correct this as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. The CFM arrived during the inspection. CDI. Please provide a CFM during all operating hours. If there is only one CFM at this site, it is highly recommended that more staff get trained and certified.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. There were no paper towels at the bar hand washing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. The PIC corrected this during the inspection.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. There was no hand soap provided at the bar hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. The PIC corrected this during the inspection.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw eggs were stored over salad dressing in the prep unit.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. The PIC corrected this during the inspection by moving the raw eggs. CDI.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: the bar dish machine was not sanitizing. The chlorine concentration for the final rinse was 0 ppm.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. Discontinue using the bar dish machine. Contact the service technician for service. Contact your EHS when it is corrected.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: the food thermometer was visibly soiled and had food debris on it.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. The PIC corrective this during the inspection by cleaning and sanitizing the thermometer. CDI.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cheese and fruit and cheese pastries (pastelitos) were being held at room temperature and were 67º.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Pastries such as the cheese and cheese and fruit pastelitos which contain cheese are considered TCS foods that must be held either hot or cold, and not at room temperature. The PIC was advised to serve the pastries within the next hour. The PIC decided to put these pastries on time as a public health control (TPHC). A TPHC agreement will be created and entered into the record. Be sure to create a system to track how long the cheese-containing pastries have been out of temperature control and when they must be discarded. Colada Shop (Inspection Date: 04/07/2026) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: container of Mostaza mix (mustard mix) had a prepared date of March 24, 2026 and an expiration date of April 16, 2026.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. The maximum time a food product made in house can be held is 7 days. Something made on March 24 expires on March 30 and not April 16. The product was discarded. CDI.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: spoons and other utensils were being stored in 74º standing water at the coffee station.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. The PIC cleaned and sanitized the equipment and utensils and will stored the utensils dry and clean and sanitize them every 4 hours, or more frequently if needed. CDI.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: the bar dishwasher machine is not working properly.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Have the bar dishwashing machine service soon as possible.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. There is no test kit for chlorine on the premises.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a test kit for chlorine as soon as possible, within 10 days. The PIC stated she had already ordered a new test kit.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Protective Shielding on Infrared/Heat Lamp Bulbs
violations.observation: Observed that a proper protective shield is not provided for the heat lamp on lightbulb over the pass through counter/window.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a shield to surround and extend beyond the bulb so that only the face of the bulb is exposed or install a coated bulb. Alternatively, the bulb could be removed if not being used.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: The person in charge could not locate the employee health documents for the establishment
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. The EHS provided the person in charge with a copy of the model FCHD documents which the PIC will go over with employees and have them sign. Have them signed before the follow-up inspection. Colada Shop (Inspection Date: 10/08/2025) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events. The person in charge (PIC) could not locate the vomiting and diarrheal clean-up policy.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. The EHS provided the PIC with a copy of the FCHD model policy which the PIC will implement.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. A food employee did not wash hands before putting gloves on to make a sandwich.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. The EHS spoke with the food employee and the PIC about this.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee(s) was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: the food employee started to make a sandwich using bare hands.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. The EHS and the PIC spoke with the food employee about this. The food employee washed their hands and donned gloves before preparing food again.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: a case of raw liquid whole eggs was stored over milk, produce and other ready to eat foods in the walk-in.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. The PIC moved the egg product to the bottom shelf.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: a two-quart container of fat free milk stored on top of ice in the front ice bin was 50F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The EHS spoke with the food employee, who added more ice to the ice bin to surround the milk container in ice. Be sure to store food containers in ice so the contents of the container are below the ice line, not on top of ice.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: a container of marinated mushrooms prepared on 9/27/25 was in the walk-in.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. The product should have been discarded on 10/3/25. The PIC discarded the product.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: There were two unlabeled chemical spray bottles near the three compartment sink area and one on the front bar area.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. The PIC labeled the three bottles during the visit.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. The PIC placed the wet wiping cloth in the sanitizer solution.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: several spoons at the drink prep station were stored in 76F standing water.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. The PIC cleaned and sanitized the spoons.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: the bar warewashing machine sanitizer feed line was broken, so no sanitizer was getting to the machine.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Contact a technician to have the machine repaired. Use the warewashing machine in the kitchen until repaired.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the back prep table is blocked by a rolling cart, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC moved rolling cart.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: guava and cheese pastries.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. Items marked with end point.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils Air Drying
violations.observation: Food containers were found stacked while wet after cleaning and chemical sanitization.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining before contact with food. PIC separated items to air dry.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED AN UNAPPROVED SPLITTER ON THE MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS SHARED A PICTURE OF APPROVED SPLITTER WITH CFM. PLEASE REPLACE THE UNAPPROVED SPLITTER WITH AN APPROVED ONE AND FORWARD THE SERVICE REPORT TO EHS WITHIN 3 CALENDAR DAYS.
